name: Zod Validation
rationale: Zod validation should define trustworthy input/output boundaries without coupling UI components to server validation, secret parsing, or database schemas.

fileRules.name: Zod Validation Boundary
fileRules.rule: Validation schemas used across transport boundaries should live outside UI components and server secret/config parsing.
fileRules.trigger: A UI/page/screen file imports schema validation libraries directly.
fileRules.recommendation: Move reusable schemas to src/shared/validation or a feature-owned validation module.
fileRules.goodExample: src/shared/validation/userInput.ts exports a schema used by a route and form.
fileRules.badExample: A page component defines Zod schemas, server config parsing, and rendering in one file.

detectors.description: Flags validation libraries imported from UI/page files.

moduleBoundaries: Shared validation may be imported by UI and server code only when it contains no server secrets or persistence concerns.
Server config/env parsing belongs in server-owned config modules.
testingExpectations: Add parse success/failure tests for important validation schemas.
agentInstructions: Create validation modules before wiring forms, routes, or tool inputs that need shared schemas.
